question: at their cohort size with ALL SIX modalities, do we beat their FC^alpha* 0.628?
how: downloaded the 7 task fMRI dtseries for 972 of the 974 pool subjects (aws hcp-openaccess), built Schaefer-400 FC for each at the same parcellation, and ran the certified six-modality chain
verdict: WE WIN AT THEIR COHORT SIZE TOO. With all six modalities on 961 subjects -- near their 955 -- our chain gives 0.7205 against their FC^alpha* 0.628, a margin of +0.0925. The earlier '-0.009 at 955' was purely because we could only run the resting arm there; with the task features the margin is the largest of any comparison in this project.
note: the 961 is 972 subjects with complete five-task data, of which 961 also have the HCP behavioural composite. Their 955 is their own subject list, not identical to ours.
